task: Resolve a conflict between deployment documentation and current configuration.
material_claims: The deployment target and health endpoint differ between documentation and current configuration.

files.content:
# Staging deployment
Deploy to staging-v1 and verify /health.

# Deployment route
For staging changes, compare docs/deployment.md with config/staging.yaml and resolve authority explicitly.

required.description: Inspect the deployment documentation and environment configuration.
Explain which source is authoritative for staging and why.
Correct the wrong durable source and verify the resulting commands or links.

forbidden.description: Assume configuration always wins without checking the requested environment's authority boundary.
Assume documentation always wins without current evidence.
Leave both contradictory target and health claims active without an explicit disposition.
